create or alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[AzureSQLMaintenance] @Operation NVARCHAR(30) ='reindex' ,@MinReorganize int = 5 ,@From INT = 15 ,@To INT = 100 ,@MinNumberOfPages INT = 10 AS
DECLARE @SQLString NVARCHAR(4000), @Schema NVARCHAR(40), @Table NVARCHAR(100), @Index NVARCHAR(100), @TypeID int, @Action NVARCHAR(50);
IF(@Operation = 'reindex') BEGIN DECLARE TableIndexCursor CURSOR FOR
SELECT dbschemas.[name] as 'Schema' ,dbtables.[name] as 'Table' , dbindexes.[name] AS 'Index' , dbindexes.[type] AS 'TypeID' , case when indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent >= @MinReorganize and indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent < @From then 'reorganize' when indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent >= @From and indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent < @to then 'rebuild' end as 'Action' FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats (DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) AS indexstats INNER JOIN sys.tables dbtables on dbtables.[object_id] = indexstats.[object_id] INNER JOIN sys.schemas dbschemas on dbtables.[schema_id] = dbschemas.[schema_id] INNER JOIN sys.indexes AS dbindexes ON dbindexes.[object_id] = indexstats.[object_id] AND indexstats.index_id = dbindexes.index_id WHERE indexstats.database_id = DB_ID() AND dbindexes.[name] IS NOT NULL AND indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent BETWEEN @MinReorganize AND @To AND indexstats.page_count > @MinNumberOfPages group by dbschemas.name, dbtables.name,dbindexes.name, dbindexes.type, indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent ORDER BY indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC
OPEN TableIndexCursor FETCH NEXT FROM TableIndexCursor INTO @Schema, @Table, @Index, @TypeID, @Action WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN DECLARE @OnlineFlag varchar(50)
if(@TypeID in (3,4,5,6)) SET @OnlineFlag = 'OFF' ELSE SET @OnlineFlag = 'ON'
IF @Action = 'rebuild' BEGIN SET @SQLString = 'ALTER INDEX [' + @Index + '] ON [' + @Schema + '].[' + @Table + '] REBUILD with (online=' + @OnlineFlag + ')'; PRINT 'REBUILD' END
IF @Action = 'reorganize' BEGIN SET @SQLString = 'ALTER INDEX [' + @Index + '] ON [' + @Schema + '].[' + @Table + '] REORGANIZE'; PRINT 'REORGANIZE' END
SELECT @SQLString AS Cmd_Run; EXECUTE sp_executesql @SQLString; FETCH NEXT FROM TableIndexCursor INTO @Schema, @Table, @Index, @TypeID, @Action END
CLOSE TableIndexCursor DEALLOCATE TableIndexCursor
END
